label: TP
reason: User input from HTTP header flows directly to the response via encodeForHTML() which outputs the encoded content unconditionally. The substring operation in doSomething only removes the last character if length > 1, but still passes potentially malicious strings to the encoder. The sink writes the result to response.getWriter(), confirming XSS risk.

evidence.note: Header input decoded and passed through doSomething then written to response via encodeForHTML
